title: Classic Sand
body:
Description

Classic sand is a type of node that spawns in the Classic Biome.

You can find them in the beach.

Trivia

  • It was added to the game as a reward for hitting 20 million visits.
  • The refined and forged variants are mistakenly titled "Stone"
  • It originally only spawned for a limited time after a visit milestone was hit, and could only be obtained by trading or when another visit milestone was being made.
